QuestInfo.2: You received an awesome gift from Lady Blair.

0.msg: I'm freezing! There's no place to get out of all this snow.

1.msg: Can't even get out of the snow on your own... Unbelievable! You're just like Blae.

2.msg: Blair, help. I'm freezing, and I need help. It's hard to feel 'lovely' when I'm getting hypothermia.

3.msg: I do care about you, #b#h0##k, but I mustn't be so easy on you! If you come back wearing all of the #rLovely Dazzlers#k set, I'll help you get out of the snow, and give you a warm place to wait for your lover.

4.msg:
#i3801576\r
I have the #i3018635##b#t3018635##k ready.
Will you accept?
#r(You can only participate in this event once per world.)

yes.0: Please come back after equipping all of the #rLovely Dazzlers Set#k.

0.msg: I'm about to freeze to death. Do you really have to make me jump through all these hoops before you can give me a place to get out of the snow?

1.msg: So, what, you won't do it?

2.msg: ...I'll go take care of it. But you stick with me, all right?
